reviews.text: Excellent managers, a very nice place to let your dogs play educational games.
Super professional and super welcoming in all sports and leisure moments!
We had a fantastic experience with Daniela and Alessandro. Their expertise, expertise, and empathy for dogs are truly incredible. We're thrilled to continue this journey with them and our dog!

I took my dog ​​to boarding for a week many years ago. When I took her back, the tall, tanned man told me, "Next time we'll make them pay for the damages." Given that she was a true angel, she was always kept inside, suffering. When they opened the cage, the man didn't want me to go and look. She escaped into my arms and ran away in the car, never letting go. I immediately realized, from the man's very unpleasant behavior and the dog's suffering, that if I had arrived a day later, I would have found her dead! Now, seeing other reviews, I remembered everything and wrote, and I'm not the only one with a terrible, negative experience. When the man said those nasty words to me, I immediately thought, "When will you see me again?" Never bring dogs to this place!!!!!!!!!
Amazing place!!!! Wonderful people with big hearts for everyone!
My dog's second home. We love this place and all the staff.

Luckily, I met Daniela, Alessandro, and all the Valletta educators in general, who take care of my little rascal every day when they're at work. Professionalism, expertise, availability, and passion for our little animals are the qualities you'll find here.
A dream team!

I just have to thank this center for the love and professionalism they put into their work. My stray dog, fearful of the world and suffering from severe separation anxiety, has managed to overcome her problems and even retire peacefully. And when I see her wagging her tail happily every time I bring her... well, that's worth more than all the words I can say. Thank you.

The valley is the ideal place for our furry friends. We started an agility course with Alessandra, who is very well prepared! My Belle is happy to go.
I recommend going.

I came to the La Valletta dog training center and met instructor Daniela Fazzi, and I had a great time.
The lesson takes place in the pool, which is helpful because Toby uses all his muscles while swimming.

What surprises me (and also makes me a little angry) is that even my second Border Collie goes crazy with joy when she "senses" that I'm about to take her to "her" school.... If only I had such good and friendly "teachers"............

Daniela was fantastic with me and my dachshund Otto: we did
dog training, nose work, and swimming in the pool, and we had a great time. She's a knowledgeable, patient professional who truly understands each dog and its owner. Thanks to her, Otto has improved tremendously (and so have I). Every lesson has always been a positive, fun, and helpful experience. Highly recommended!

I kenneled my dog ​​in Valletta for three days. He had already attended behavior classes there as a puppy, and had also spent a few days there, completely relaxed, just like my two previous dogs, and therefore with the utmost trust on my part. Unfortunately, this time the experience was absolutely not positive: as soon as I picked him up, my dog, wet and freezing, literally fled the place, jumped into the trunk of the car, where he usually has difficulty getting in, and began crying softly, continuing for over two hours. He subsequently vomited profusely twice during the day, but without any other symptoms attributable to gastroenteritis, and therefore unmistakably emotional in nature, and he avoided every attempt at petting.
It took days to dispel his distrust of humans and some obvious insecurity.
Let's just say I'm very perplexed and disoriented.
nice place with professional staff

I've been attending "La Valletta" for 2 years with my dog, who does agility. He's been supported every step of the way. In the summer, we do it in the pool. The school is well-equipped, and the instructors are very good, professional, knowledgeable, and patient, even with the handlers. It's a great place if you want to build a good bond with your furry friend!
